subject: general
question: Choose the odd one out.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
 

 Kingfisher Airlines
 Defunct
 
 

 Air Deccan
 Defunct
 
 

 Indigo Airlines
 Operational
 
 

 Jet Airways
 Defunct
 
 

 

Kingfisher Airlines, Air Deccan, Jet Airways all are Defunct airlines,

Whereas,

Indigo Airlines is an Operational airline.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Indigo Airlines**".
